title: Arquiteto De Redes
description:
Arquiteto de Redes Core

Início Imediato

Contrato CLT (Projeto de 6 meses)

Local: Rio de Janeiro/RJ – Híbrido (3x por semana presencial)

Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Avançado (obrigatório)


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Redes Core altamente qualificado(a) e estratégico(a) para um projeto com duração de 6 meses. Esta é uma posição sênior , com foco em fornecer orientações especializadas de rede para o cliente. Você atuará como um consultor técnico de confiança, traduzindo necessidades complexas em soluções de alto nível que sustentam uma operação empresarial robusta e diversificada.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenho de Soluções para o Cliente : Responsável pelo design arquitetônico de projetos relacionados a redes. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento e a apresentação de soluções de rede completas, alinhadas às necessidades de uma empresa global de bens de consumo, com sedes corporativas, fábricas, centros de distribuição e lojas. O foco está na estratégia e arquitetura de alto nível — não na implementação ou configuração.
  • Suporte a RFPs e Negócios : Atuar como especialista técnico em redes durante processos de RFP (Request for Proposal), elaborando propostas técnicas detalhadas, modelos de custo e apresentando soluções para as áreas técnica e executiva do cliente.
  • Consultoria Técnica Estratégica : Ser um conselheiro técnico confiável para a LOREAL , orientando sobre estratégias de rede, seleção de tecnologias e melhores práticas. Garantir que as soluções estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de longo prazo da empresa, como transformação digital, e-commerce e otimização da cadeia de suprimentos global.
  • Conhecimento Multicamadas : Fornecer liderança arquitetônica em todas as camadas da rede — desde a Camada 1 (física) , incluindo fibra óptica, até Camadas 2 e 3 (switching, roteamento e protocolos). Ter experiência com redes que suportam grandes volumes de dados, vídeo e sensores IoT é altamente desejável.
  • Colaboração Global : Trabalhar de forma eficaz com times distribuídos globalmente, garantindo execução fluida dos projetos e comunicação clara.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência : 10+ anos em engenharia e arquitetura de redes, com histórico comprovado em projetos de grande escala para clientes corporativos. Preferência para experiência nos setores de bens de consumo, varejo ou manufatura .
  • RFPs : Experiência prévia com suporte técnico em RFPs empresariais, incluindo elaboração de designs técnicos, modelos de custos e documentação de propostas.
  • Conhecimento Técnico Profundo : Compreensão avançada das camadas de rede:
  • Camada 1 : Fibra óptica, DWDM;
  • Camada 2 : Ethernet, switching;
  • Camada 3 : Roteamento IP, BGP, OSPF.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação : Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos em linguagem clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Visão Estratégica : Experiência comprovada em cargos estratégicos e não operacionais, com foco em design de alto nível e governança.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente : Vivência anterior em posições de contato direto com o cliente, atuando como conselheiro técnico.
  • Certificações : Certificações relevantes como CCIE ou outras reconhecidas na área de arquitetura e design de redes são um diferencial.


Mais informações serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Professor Escolar
description:
A Diretoria do CSVP torna pública a abertura de inscrições e a realização do Processo Seletivo de docentes para atuação na Educação Infantil, nos anos iniciais e finais do Ensino Fundamental e no Ensino Médio, em sua sede, no Cosme Velho, por meio de prova objetiva, prática e avaliação de currículo, a ser realizado no período que se estende pelos meses de outubro e novembro.


Processo seletivo simplificado

Destina-se à formação de cadastro de candidatos para ministrar aulas presenciais aos estudantes da Educação Infantil, dos Anos Iniciais e Finais do Ensino Fundamental e do Ensino Médio do CSVP, para o ano letivo de 2026.


Requisitos:


Habilitação


Para Educação Infantil e Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental, os portadores de diploma de:

a) Curso Normal Superior;

b) Licenciatura em Pedagogia / Pedagogia para atuação na Educação Infantil e Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental

c) Habilitação Específica para o Magistério e Diploma do Curso Normal de Nível Médio;

d) Programa Especial de Formação Pedagógica Superior, qualquer que seja a nomenclatura do Curso, com habilitação em Magistério da Educação Infantil e dos Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental.


Para Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e Ensino Médio, os portadores de diploma de Licenciatura Plena em um dos componentes curriculares da BNCC.


No caso específico do componente curricular de Educação Física, a abertura de contrato está vinculada somente aos habilitados e à apresentação do registro no Conselho Regional de Educação Física - CREF.


Qualificação


Para Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e Ensino Médio:

a) portadores de diploma de licenciatura plena, independentemente da existência de 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos na disciplina a ser atribuída, desde que esta seja da mesma área do conhecimento;

b) portadores de diploma de Licenciatura Curta, na área de formação acadêmica ou disciplina a ser atribuída;

c) estudantes de Licenciatura Plena, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos da disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso;

d) portadores de diploma de Bacharel ou de Tecnólogo de nível superior, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos, na área de conhecimento ou disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso;

e) estudantes de Bacharelado ou de Tecnologia de nível superior, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos na área de conhecimento ou disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso.


Inclusão e igualdade de oportunidades


Com o objetivo de promover a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, o presente processo dará especial atenção para candidatos que integrem grupos historicamente marginalizados (por exemplo: pessoas com deficiência – PcD −, indígenas, mulheres, negros, pessoas incluídas no acrônimo LGBTQIAPN+, idosos.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.


A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.


More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

description:

description:

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.

Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.


Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.


Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.


Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.


At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.


Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP;
VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN;
and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.


Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.G. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.


Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.


Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.


Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.


Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.


Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.


Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.G. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.G. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Node.Js - Mecanismo De Busca
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend com foco em mecanismos de busca , que trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as equipes internas e os clientes para compreender e analisar as necessidades dos projetos.


Seu dia a dia envolverá a implementação de soluções robustas e performáticas utilizando Node.Js , com ênfase em escalabilidade, qualidade de código e integrações com mecanismos de busca (Typesense, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch ou similares).


Este(a) profissional estará envolvido(a) em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação. Sua participação ativa em discussões técnicas, revisões de código e colaboração com arquitetos e gerentes de projeto será essencial para garantir soluções eficientes e inovadoras.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Entender requisitos técnicos e de negócio, propondo soluções eficientes com Node.Js.
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis e resilientes utilizando Node.Js, aplicando princípios de engenharia de software.
  • Trabalhar em APIs RESTful e integrações com serviços de terceiros.
  • Projetar e otimizar soluções de busca utilizando Typesense, Elasticsearch ou mecanismos similares.
  • Colaborar com o time em revisões de código, pair programming e discussões técnicas.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com ideias e feedbacks.
  • Documentar adequadamente os sistemas e serviços desenvolvidos.
  • Se manter atualizado com tendências tecnológicas e promover melhorias no time e nos produtos.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Sólido conhecimento em Node.Js e experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas com a linguagem.
  • Experiência prática com mecanismos de busca (Typesense, Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch ou similares).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks do ecossistema Node.Js (Express, NestJS etc.).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento em princípios SOLID, clean code, design patterns e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Uso avançado de Git (incluindo resolução de conflitos e boas práticas de versionamento).
  • Vivência com mensageria/eventos (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, etc.).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).


Você irá se destacar e será considerado diferencial se:

  • Experiência com Go (Golang) no desenvolvimento de serviços backend.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (DataDog, NewRelic, Dynatrace) e implementação de dashboards.
  • Implementação de telemetria com OpenTelemetry.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de resiliência.
  • Experiência com gRPC e SSE (Server-Sent Events).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura hexagonal.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mock para APIs REST.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

title: Representante De Desarrollo De Ventas
description:
We are seeking English-fluent speakers for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) role . The ideal candidate is great at building relationships and is not afraid of picking up the phone and making calls, and thrives in high-paced environments. You will play a key role in identifying and generating new business opportunities, building strong relationships, and setting the foundation for sales success. If you have excellent communication skills, fluent English, and are driven by results, we want to hear from you!


Key Responsibilities:


  • Conduct outbound sales activities via phone, email, and social media to generate leads and schedule qualified meetings.
  • Use CRMs to track, manage, and organize sales activities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our products and services to effectively pitch and answer customer questions.
  • Collaborate closely with the sales and marketing teams to optimize lead generation and follow-up strategies.
  • Build and maintain relationships with prospects, ensuring a smooth handoff to the sales team.
  • Maintain a highly organized workflow to meet daily, weekly, and monthly goals.
  • Actively contribute ideas and strategies to improve the sales process.


Required Skills and Qualifications:


  • English fluent speaker.
  • 2-4 years of professional experience in high-paced environments.
  • Ownership mentality: Proactive, accountable, and able to take initiative to drive results.
  • Extroverted and comfortable with outbound calls to potential clients.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build rapport quickly.
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.


Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications):


  • Experience using CRM systems to manage sales pipelines and track prospects.
  • Experience selling SaaS products.
  • Enthusiasm for technology and innovation.

title: Coordenador De Planejamento De Operações | Prevenção De Perdas
description:
Descrição da vaga


Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.


Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:


  • Gerenciar equipe;
  • Contatar fornecedores;
  • Gerenciar projetos;
  • Realizar manutenção de equipamentos.


Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:


  • Conhecimento técnico nas áreas de engenharia (Leitura de Plantas);
  • Experiencia comnegociações;
  • Conhecimento doPacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).


OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.


Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:


Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.


Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ.


Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!


Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.


Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma;
priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias;
valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .


Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio

description:
Estão abertas as inscrições para o Programa de Estágio Kincaid Talents!

Se você aprecia desafios, é uma pessoa proativa e tem sede de aprendizado, venha se juntar ao nosso time.


Reforçamos que no Kincaid respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças. Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso!


Se você está cursando Direito entre o 5º e 7º período e tem disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas por dia em modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro, vem com a gente!



Benefícios

  • Vale refeição e/ou alimentação;
  • Plataforma de Saúde Mental
  • Gympass;
  • Iniciativas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Happy day (folga no dia de aniversário);
  • Auxílio transporte;


Nossa história começou em 1932 e, desde então, acumulamos vasta experiência na prestação de assessoria jurídica a clientes nacionais e internacionais.


Atuamos em diversas áreas, com destaque em direito marítimo, tributário e aduaneiro, societário, regulatório, contencioso e arbitragem, seguros e resseguros, portos e infraestrutura, energia, óleo e gás, ambiental, trabalhista, aviação, compliance, ferroviário e setor público.


Estamos localizados no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brasília e Vitória, com atuação em todo território nacional.


Somos um escritório de advocacia full service especializado nos setores de infra-estrutura, comércio e logística. Nosso propósito no Kincaid é criar uma equipe multidisciplinar, sempre pronta para entregar as melhores soluções jurídicas para os clientes. Investimos nos nossos profissionais e no ambiente de trabalho buscando sempre o desenvolvimento de uma carreira transformadora!


No Kincaid respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças. Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso!


Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Consultor(A) De Vendas - Rio De Janeiro
description:
Estamos selecionando Consultor especializado para atuar junto a classe médica afim de promover a divulgação das opções terapêuticas disponíveis, bem contribuir para o posicionamento da Celltrion Brasil como empresa referência em produção de medicamentos biológicos.


Responsabilidades:


  • Responsável pela visitação médica, venda e geração de demanda de produtos dentro da região de atuação.
  • Participar das negociações, sendo responsável por todo o processo de vendas;
  • Gerenciar estrategicamente as principais contas do território, monitorando estoques, possíveis rupturas e descontos praticados com os produtos promovidos, tomando ações para atingir/superar metas;
  • Manter atualizada a ferramenta de CRM médico, garantindo a presença de potenciais profissionais de saúde no painel de visitação.
  • Conhecimento avançado do mercado (concorrentes, clientes e Jornada do Paciente) e das principais contas e clientes, compartilhando informações com as áreas internas, propondo novas ideias, ações e projetos que ampliem a demanda por nossos produtos.
  • Atuar como consultor especializado às partes interessadas (médicos, farmacêuticos, hospitais, clínicas, instituições... etc), influenciando o processo de tomada de decisão;
  • Analisar e interpretar o desempenho do produto/cliente através de relatórios disponíveis e outras fontes de informação;
  • Idealizar, propor, promover e planejar eventos e promoções científicas junto às áreas de marketing/médica, sugerindo palestrantes e temas, visando contribuir para a atualização científica dos interessados, ampliar o entendimento sobre produtos, patologia e acesso ao tratamento.
  • Cumprir todas as normas e procedimentos legais e de farmacovigilância definidos pela empresa em suas ações de relacionamento técnico comercial.



Qualificações


Graduação nas áreas de Marketing, Farmácia, Administração ou correlatos.

Desejável Pós-graduação.


Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência na indústria farmacêutica, atuando como consultor especializado nos mercados de oncologia, hematologia ou alto custo.

Experiencia em Gastroenterologia e Reumatologia será um diferencial.


Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.

Desejável inglês intermediário/avançado (poderá ser testado).


Sales Force/Veeva CRM



Informações adicionais


Contratação CLT: Salário + Benefícios

Rio de Janeiro - RJ


A Celltrion visa a igualdade e considera candidatos para fazer parte do time independente de sexo, raça, cor, orientação sexual, identidade de genero, idade, religião ou deficiência.

title: Tech Lead Java/React
description:

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em liderança técnica de squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

  • Conhecimentos práticos em React para front-end.
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de pacotes do Maven.

  • Boa comunicação, colaboração em equipe e espírito inovador.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Turing is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer, Integrated Marketing to produce visually compelling designs across diverse marketing channels. This role focuses on creating on-brand advertising campaigns, presentation templates, brand guidelines, digital assets, and integrated marketing initiatives.

Collaborating closely with marketing designers embedded across business units, you’ll maintain and evolve Turing’s visual identity, leveraging the latest creative tools and staying ahead of design trends to deliver exceptional brand experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Production: Create compelling graphics and creative assets for integrated marketing initiatives including advertising campaigns, social media, email, presentations, digital content, and events.
  • Brand Consistency: Support and evolve Turing’s visual design system and brand guidelines, maintaining templates, design libraries, and visual standards across internal and external communications.
  • Collaboration and Alignment: Partner closely with embedded marketing designers, copywriters, and internal stakeholders to ensure cohesive visual storytelling and consistent brand execution across teams.
  • Presentation and Asset Development: Develop polished, professional, end-to-end presentation templates that minimize the need for end-user customization (Google Slides, PowerPoint);
    and creation of other marketing collateral that clearly communicate brand messaging and positioning.
  • Market and Trend Awareness: Stay current with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies to continuously improve creative quality, innovation, and execution speed.


Requirements

  • 9+ years of graphic design experience, preferably in technology, AI, SaaS, or similar industries.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and Canva
  • Strong working knowledge of presentation tools (Google Slides and PowerPoint). Deep understanding of master slides, theme building, and layout systems in both platforms.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools for design (e.G., Midjourney, Runway, Adobe Firefly) to enhance creative output and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and integrated marketing principles.
  • Demonstrated experience with design systems, brand guidelines, and visual identity management across diverse channels.
  • Excellent collaboration, organizational, and communication skills, able to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive learner comfortable working remotely in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience designing client-facing presentations, such as pitch decks and sales materials, with a focus on clear visual storytelling, data visualization, and adherence to brand standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing within AI, tech, or rapidly scaling startup environments.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics, video editing software (After Effects, Premiere Pro), or AI-driven motion tools.
  • Portfolio showcasing integrated marketing campaigns, presentation materials (powerpoint and/or google slides), and consistent brand execution across channels.
  • Familiarity with global and multi-audience brand challenges.

title: Financeiro
description:
Analista Financeiro Regulatório (Pleno/Sênior) — Simpay (Instituição de Pagamento)


Sobre a Simpay

A Simpay é uma Instituição de Pagamento focada em meios de pagamento digitais e PIX, em transição para operações cada vez mais diretas e reguladas. Buscamos alguém mão-na-massa, extremamente organizado e com rigor regulatório para cuidar do fluxo financeiro diário e das obrigações junto ao Banco Central .

Missão da vaga

Garantir envios diários e periódicos ao BCB com acurácia e pontualidade , manter reconciliações financeiras em dia e apoiar a contabilidade no cumprimento de CCS e integrações APIX , assegurando plena aderência às normas aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento.


Responsabilidades (o que você fará no dia a dia)


  • Envios diários ao BCB (via APIX/RSFN, quando aplicável) :
  • Posições de saldo em contas (contas de pagamento, contas de liquidação e correlatas).
  • Fluxos/saldos enviados a participantes responsáveis/liquidantes.
  • Conferência de retornos, logs e reprocessamentos quando necessário.
  • Reconciliação financeira e operacional :
  • Conciliação diária entre core de pagamentos , banco/liquidante, SPI/PIX e razão contábil.
  • Tratamento de pendências (ajustes, divergências, estornos/devoluções) com trilha de auditoria.
  • Apoio à contabilidade em rotinas regulatórias :
  • CCS (Cadastro de Clientes do SFN) : coleta de dados, validação e acompanhamento de envios/retornos.
  • Integrações APIX : suporte funcional às cargas/consultas, evidências dos envios e SLAs.
  • Preparação de dossiês e evidências para auditorias internas/externas e fiscalizações do BCB.
  • Calendário regulatório da IP :
  • Manter o calendário de obrigações sempre atualizado (diárias, mensais, trimestrais, anuais).
  • Sinalizar riscos de prazo, antecipar bloqueios e propor planos de ação.
  • Indicadores e reporting :
  • Consolidar e reportar dashboards de acurácia/pontualidade dos envios , posição de saldos, ageing de reconciliações e status de CCS/APIX.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais para Diretoria (Finanças/Compliance/Operações).


Requisitos


  • Experiência prévia em Finanças/Backoffice/Controladoria em fintech, IP, banco, subadquirente ou similar.
  • Vivência com obrigações regulatórias do BCB para IP (ex.: CCS, integrações APIX , posições de saldo, evidências e trilha de auditoria).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado (proc-x, Tabela Dinâmica, validações).
  • Noções de SQL para consultas simples em bases transacionais/BI.
  • Atenção a detalhes, raciocínio contábil e disciplina de processos.
  • Comunicação clara para interface com Contabilidade, Operações, Risco/PLD-FT e parceiros.


Diferenciais (bons de ter)


  • Experiência com SPI/PIX , RSFN, participantes responsáveis/liquidantes.
  • Familiaridade com normas recentes do BCB aplicáveis a IPs (ex.: Resoluções BCB 429/2024, 496/2025, 506/2025, 507/2025 , entre outras).
  • Python para automação de rotinas/checagens e BigQuery/PostgreSQL .
  • Experiência com conciliação de carteiras (cartão, PIX, split, subcontas) e indicadores operacionais (ex.: devoluções/MED, ageing).


Competências comportamentais


  • Rigor (99,9%+ de acurácia), senso de propriedade e urgência .
  • Organização, gestão de prazos e visão de processo ponta-a-ponta.
  • Capacidade de documentar bem e sustentar evidências em auditorias.


KPIs da função (como mediremos seu sucesso)


  • Pontualidade dos envios obrigatórios (meta: 100% dentro do prazo D+0/D+1, conforme obrigação).
  • Acurácia dos arquivos/posições (meta: ≥ 99,9% ).
  • Reconciliações concluídas diariamente (meta: 100% D+1 sem pendências críticas).
  • Zero falhas não tratadas em APIX/CCS (meta: 0 incidentes críticos por mês).
  • SLA de resposta a áreas internas/BCB/auditores (meta: ≤ 1 dia útil ).


Modelo de trabalho


  • Local: Remoto.
  • Regime: PJ.
  • Disponibilidade para janela operacional de envios/concilições no início do dia.

title: Analista De Fp&A Pleno
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Analista de FP&A Pleno para atuar em um projeto temporário junto a um de nossos clientes do setor de óleo e gás! Essa oportunidade seria para um contrato de 6 meses (com possibilidade de extensão) para atuar de forma 100% presencial no escritório do Rio de Janeiro (RJ).


O(A) Analista Pleno de FP&A deve deter forte capacidade analítica, visão de negócio e domínio em gestão de custos e investimentos, para atuar diretamente no acompanhamento do OPEX, CAPEX, G&A e análise de rentabilidade de produtos derivados de petróleo e gás. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir visibilidade financeira, apoiar a tomada de decisão e contribuir para a eficiência operacional da companhia.


Atividades:

  • Realizar o planejamento, controle e análise de OPEX e CAPEX por unidade de negócio (Refinaria, Terminais, UPGN, etc.);
  • Elaborar e acompanhar projeções, forecast e análises de variação (real vs. orçado);
  • Apoiar na consolidação e controle das despesas G&A, garantindo o alinhamento com as diretrizes orçamentárias;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar modelos de rentabilidade por produto e família (ex: GLP, C5+, Diesel S-500, MGO, QAV, VLSFO, gasolina, RAT);
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas operacionais e contabilidade para garantir acuracidade de dados e aderência aos centros de custo;
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade econômica e ROI para novos projetos e iniciativas de CAPEX;
  • Preparar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards com indicadores de desempenho financeiro, apoiando a alta gestão;
  • Participar ativamente do fechamento mensal e análise de resultados, propondo medidas corretivas ou de otimização de custos, bem como reclassificações de acordo com a devida alocação de custos entre as áreas;
  • Apoiar na estruturação de centros de custo e lucro alinhados à realidade operacional da refinaria;
  • Contribuir com melhoria contínua de processos, automações e controles financeiros.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas - Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou Gestão de Negócios será um diferencial;
  • Sólida experiência em FP&A, controladoria ou áreas financeiras;
  • Domínio de Excel e Power BI (obrigatório);
  • Experiência comSAP (preferencialmente módulos CO e FI);
  • Forte entendimento de estrutura de custos industriais, OPEX, CAPEX e rentabilidade de produtos;
  • Conhecimento emVBA, SQL ou outras linguagens de automação de relatórios será um diferencial;
  • Vivência no setor de óleo & gás, energia, química ou indústrias de base será um diferencial;
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação ou reorganização de estruturas de centros de custo e lucro será um diferencial.

description:

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are looking for a skilled Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and maintain web applications across the entire technology stack. This role involves working on both front-end and back-end systems, integrating APIs and databases, and ensuring scalable, high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate is proficient in modern front-end frameworks, server-side programming, and cloud-based environments, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Full-stack software development with a primary emphasis on back-end development
  • Develop and refactor serverless APIs and services written with .NET/C# (80% )
  • Develop and refactor user-facing software features using Angular (20% )
  • Build reusable code and libraries for future use
  • Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and usability

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience with Angular, Angular Materials, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3. (20%)

  • Deep knowledge of software design principles, patterns, and best practices (e.G., SOLID, Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience Strong background in application security, authentication/authorization (e.G., OAuth2, OpenID Connect, IdPs like Auth0/Okta).
  • Experience working with multi-tenant, large-scale distributed systems.

title: Crm Architect
description:
We are currently looking for a seasoned CRM Architect to join our dynamic team. This remote role is an exciting opportunity for a professional with a strong background in Microsoft Dynamics CRM development and leadership skills. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of CRM architecture, be experienced in crafting customer-facing pages, and be adept at leading a team of junior developers. As a key player in our organization, you will drive the development and integration of CRM solutions to enhance our customer engagement and streamline business processes.


Job Duties and Responsibilities:


- Lead the development and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.

- Design, build, and maintain customer-facing pages on the CRM Portal using both out-of-the-box capabilities and customizations.

- Oversee the CRM data model creation and participate actively in its design and maintenance.

- Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and provide expert guidance on best practices in CRM development.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate CRM with Azure, Power Automate, and other essential systems.

- Develop and deploy custom applications within Dynamics CRM, ensuring high performance and adherence to business requirements.

- Facilitate seamless integration of CRM with other systems, ensuring data consistency and accessibility.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to the CRM environment.

- Keep abreast of new CRM features and technologies, advocating for the adoption of innovations that can benefit the organization.


Qualifications:


- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5-12 years of experience in CRM development, with a focus on Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

- Proven track record as a lead developer with experience in guiding and mentoring junior team members.

- Strong understanding of CRM architecture and data modeling principles.

- Professional experience in developing CRM Portals with a blend of out-of-the-box and custom solutions.

- Expertise in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for portal development.


Preferred Skills and Knowledge:


- Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics CRM are highly desirable.

- Knowledge of Power Automate and its integration with Dynamics CRM.

- Experience in creating apps within the Dynamics CRM platform.

- Familiarity with Azure and its services related to CRM integration.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.


Tools and Technologies:


- Microsoft Dynamics CRM

- Power Portals

- HTML, JavaScript, CSS, c# .Net

- Azure Services

- Power Automate

- Integration and API development tools


As a CRM Developer, you will be at the forefront of our CRM initiatives, driving innovation and excellence. If you are a technical expert with a passion for leading development projects and a knack for solving complex problems, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering exceptional CRM solutions that power our business success.

FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS


Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.


No FTR, utilizamos o Direito como uma ferramenta para negócios e mitigação de riscos.

Com escritórios no RJ e SP, atuação full service e multidisciplinar (desde o consultivo ao contencioso), o FTR tem como um dos seus principais pilares a inovação constante e caracteriza-se por uma dinâmica de trabalho extremamente ágil, estrutura horizontal e acesso direto aos sócios, permitindo um crescimento profissional rápido, multidisciplinar e integrado.


Há anos, o FTR impulsiona e relaciona-se com diversas startups e empresas de inovação, para utilizar a inteligência dos dados em otimização de eficiência e mitigação de riscos de clientes.

Payroll Specialist – Senior

The Payroll Specialist will be responsible for leading end-to-end payroll operations for multiple clients across in Brazil. This role ensures full compliance with local regulations, accuracy in payroll processing, and timely delivery in accordance with client-specific agreements. The position is also key driving continuous process improvement, automation initiatives, and managing a cross-functional team.


Job Summary – Senior Payroll Specialist (BIPO Brazil)

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Hybrid)

Role type: Payroll Operational and client-facing contact window

Language requirement: Intermediate-advanced English (spoken and written, for reporting and calls)



Key Responsibilities:

  • Procced and Operate the end-to-end payroll process (monthly, semimonthly, weekly) for multiple clients in Mexico
  • Ensure compliance with local labor, tax, and social security laws in Brazil
  • Perform payroll calculations in BIPO’s local payroll system, including taxes, benefits, savings funds, etc.
  • Collaborate with clients’ finance, legal, and HR departments to resolve issues, audits, and special requests.
  • Review and approve calculations for taxes, social security contributions, savings funds, Coupon, PTU and other benefits, and other applicable components.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and performance indicators (KPIs) established with clients.
  • Lead the onboarding and implementation of new clients or country operations.
  • Identify and propose process improvements, aiming to automate and optimize payroll operations.
  • Stay up to date with changes in labor and tax legislation
  • Use BIPO Platform and Payroll Calculation System to do client daily delivery
  • Keeping Client Daliy Communication and Client service delivery


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Brazil Human Resources, Accounting, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in payroll operations
  • Proven experience managing payroll and local Statutory Benefits in Brazil
  • Strong knowledge of labor and tax regulations in Brazil
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and payroll systems (e.G., Meta4, SAP, ADP, Runacetc.).
  • Intermediate to advanced English for face to face client communication (required for regional client communication).
  • Looking for someone extremely organized, urgent, accountable, and able to multitask under pressure.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in outsourcing or shared services environments.
  • Certification in payroll and Brazil labor law.
  • Familiarity with ERP integration and automation tools.
  • Has Similar Global/ Local Payroll company's work experience.

  • Ensino médio completo;

  • Experiência comvenda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;

  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;

title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences;
    to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.
Core Competencies
  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors;
    partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner;
    reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity;
    cares holistically for those served;
    maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered;
    treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.
Minimum Requirements
  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.
  • Four (4) years of responsible work experience in psychiatry.
  • A great bedside manner and the ability to remain calm, empathetic and patient while interacting with patients who suffer from severe mental disorders.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $120 per hour

title: Legal Secretary
description:
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork.

We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

As a Legal Secretary you will be responsible for supporting all AME Geo Legal commercial and administrative activity in the AME Geo, with a focus on reviewing customer RFPs, supplier agreements, and general commercial documents and deals arising in the SITA at Airports, Communications & Data Exchange products and Borders business units.

You will be a part of the overall SITA Global Legal Team of 40+ lawyers and professionals around the globe, which includes Geography-based legal teams in Singapore, Europe and Beirut, specialists/teams in M&A, Corporate Legal, Data, IPR, Sanctions, Ethics, Regulatory.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Assist AME Geo Legal attorneys in preparing, revising and organizing legal documents, including RFPs, contracts, reports, case files.
  • Conduct legal research and gather relevant information to support case preparation and strategy.
  • Manage and maintain AME Geo Legal databases and document management systems.
  • Oversee the payment process of external law firms, including raising purchase orders, revising invoices, ensuring accuracy and processing payments in a timely manner.
  • Provide administrative support to the AME GEO Legal, including managing calendars, assisting with the preparation of reports and presentations for external and internal use.
  • Communicate with external legal counsels and other stakeholders across different jurisdictions, where needed.
  • Support AME Geo Legal in various projects and initiatives as needed.
  • Maintain excellent inter-personnel communications and relationships.
  • Advising internal teams on SITA policies and procedures related to commercial contracts.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven track record in multi-national environments, particularly within the North America and Latin America regions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, legal studies or a related field.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, change-oriented commercial environment and you understand financial principles and practices in a multi-national corporate context.
  • 7+ years relevant work experience to include legal document review and comment as well as negotiation skills.
  • Excellent organization and administrative skills with attention to detail.
  • Business acumen and understanding of corporate operations and governance standards.
  • Strong project management principles (task identification and prioritization, timeline management, results focus).
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess complex situations and develop appropriate strategies.
  • Excellent written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly communicate factual matters, effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Completely fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish (written and spoken);
    all other languages a real plus.

WHAT WE OFFER:

At SITA, we disrupt the status quo, by empowering our people to pioneer innovations that touch the lives of billions. Bringing together diverse minds from across the globe, we foster a dynamic and positive workplace culture, that values our talented team members for their contributions and dedication.

Our core benefits include:

  • Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on the needs of your team and your customers)
  • Flex Day: Shape your workday to suit your life and your plans.
  • Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  • Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), available to you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year, and Champion Health - a personalized, proactive platform to support diverse wellbeing needs.
  • Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
  • Competitive Benefits: Access competitive benefits tailored to the local market and your employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Partner Marketing Director
description:

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.G. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence;
in order to succeed, weneed to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Overview

Goal of function: We are seeking a Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d) to lead and innovate Care Enablement advocacy strategies to improve external HCP stakeholder engagement and knowledge development, ultimately creating advocacy for innovative therapies. The position involves developing and organizing customized advocacy programs such as therapy educational round tables, symposia and reference center programs for targeted education and advocacy, creating opportunities to meaningfully educate and impact the practice of participants. It requires collaboration across all functions of the business units and regions (Marketing, Sales, Application, Compliance, and Medical Affairs) to develop an agile program strategy aligned with business priorities and strategic imperatives.


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation and execution of a strategic medical marketing and advocacy plan targeting external HCPs, aligned with business goals and addressing gaps, ensuring a consistent risk-based approach. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment

  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to build strong relationships with internal and external speakers to create impactful educational programs. Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. Establish and support reference centers of excellence as hubs for peer-to-peer learning and clinical demonstration

  • Oversee planning, contracting, and execution of impactful advocacy activities like commercial symposia, workshops, and conferences. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality events within medical and legal compliance frameworks

  • Lead the creation of targeted therapy content of the programs and events for diverse external audiences ensuring compliance with regulations and accreditation standards. Collaborate with KOLs on timely, creative promotion using marketing and social media platforms

  • Establish a global approval matrix for activities to ensure education programs comply with regulations and standards. Monitor and implement emerging regulatory trends

Goal of function: We are seeking a Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d) to lead and innovate Care Enablement Medical Advocacy strategies to improve external HCP stakeholder engagement and knowledge development, ultimately creating advocacy for innovative therapies. The position involves developing and organizing customized therapy programs such as educational round tables, symposia and reference center programs for targeted education and advocacy, creating opportunities to meaningfully educate and impact the practice of participants. It requires collaboration across all functions of the business units and regions (Marketing, Sales, Application, Compliance, and Medical Affairs) to develop an agile program strategy aligned with business priorities and strategic imperatives.

Responsibilities
  • Lead the creation and execution of a strategic medical marketing and advocacy plan targeting external HCPs, aligned with business goals and addressing gaps, ensuring a consistent risk-based approach. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to build strong relationships with internal and external speakers to create impactful educational programs. Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. Establish and support reference centers of excellence as hubs for peer-to-peer learning and clinical demonstration
  • Oversee planning, contracting, and execution of impactful commercial advocacy activities like symposia, workshops, and conferences. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality events within medical and legal compliance frameworks
  • Lead the creation of targeted therapy content of the programs and events for diverse external audiences ensuring compliance with regulations and accreditation standards. Collaborate with KOLs on timely, creative promotion using marketing and social media platforms

Profile

  • Min of 5-7 years of experience with advanced degree (alternatively min. of 10-15 years of experience with Master’s degree) in medical marketing, HCP education, or advocacy development within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry
  • Fluent in English, additional language skills (e.G., Dutch, German, Spanish) are a plus
  • Proven track record of building and managing KOL networks and educational initiatives
  • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks in medical communications
